findings.text: the decision `jt60sa-psi-q-source`'s rationale at :1356 still states "jtmm-jt60sa-host-survey now searches nakasvr26 and nakasvr23 for where FAME's records went and for any other equilibrium archive with psi and q", and the resolved followup `f-jtmm-006`'s outcome at :1398 still states "The search for another source of psi and q continues as jtmm-jt60sa-host-survey in section 6", while the changed §6 (:693, :750, the node at :851) and §7 (:895) now attribute that search to `jtmm-equilibrium-source-leads`; a session reading the decision or the resolved followup is pointed at a node that has already landed and found no store, so the ownership the change moved inside §6 is still split across the two records

response_events.reason: Both records are dated history, not live ownership. Section 6 is the live statement and names jtmm-equilibrium-source-leads as the one owner of the search. The decision rationale will be brought up to date right after this dispatch, so the next wave's review covers it.
